title: TikTok Parmesan-Crusted Roasted Potatoes
description: We made the viral parmesan-crusted roasted potato recipe from TikTok even better with an updated method for the crispiest potatoes.
ingredients: 1 (24 ounce) package baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Place butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish or nonstick baking pan and place in the oven until the butter melts, about 4 minutes.
While the butter melts, score potatoes about 1/4-inch-deep in a diamond pattern (crosshatch). Set aside.

Remove the pan from the oven and let cool slightly, about 2 minutes. Stir Parmesan cheese, garlic and herb seasoning, and salt into butter to form a paste. Spread about 1 teaspoon of the Parmesan paste on the cut-side of each potato; arrange, cut-side down, in the pan. Place in the preheated oven.

Bake until the potatoes are tender and the Parmesan creates a golden crust on the bottom of the potatoes, about 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before using a spatula to release potatoes from pan. Recipe developed by Julia Levy

video.description: You've probably seen this recipe for Parmesan-Crusted Roasted Potatoes all over TikTok – especially if you're on FoodTok. This video shows you how to make the viral potato recipe with baby potatoes, melted butter, garlic and herb seasoning, salt, and grated Parmesan. Pro tip: Spreading the Parmesan-butter mixture directly onto the crosshatched potatoes helped it to stick better than doing it the way you see all over TikTok (spreading the parmesan mixture in an even layer on the bottom of the baking pan and placing the potatoes on top).
video.name: How to Make TikTok's Parmesan-Crusted Roasted Potatoes
